changes.comment: sdk-ui-kit: Fix secondary buttons losing their border in apps whose stylesheet entry point pulls several SDK packages in through legacy @import. The %btn placeholder moved from styles/scss/Button/_mixins.scss to the new styles/scss/Button/_placeholders.scss so that stylesheets needing only the button gradient mixin no longer re-emit the button base rules; if you @extend %btn in your own SCSS, load @gooddata/sdk-ui-kit/styles/scss/Button/placeholders instead of Button/mixins.
